packaged_linux_roles.script:
import pathlib,subprocess,time,os,json,hashlib,resource
home=pathlib.Path('/tmp/phase62-role');home.mkdir(mode=0o700)
ini=home/'controller.ini';text='[Operation]\nTransmit = True\nTransmit Backend = nonexistent\nEnable on Boot = Always\nUse LED = True\nUse Shutdown = True\n[Security]\nPrivileged Network Safety = enforced\n';ini.write_text(text);ini.chmod(0o600)
log=home/'role.log'
with log.open('w') as output:
 started=time.monotonic()
 process=subprocess.Popen(['/artifact/wsprrypi','--controller-only','-i',str(ini),'--no-web'],stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+30
  while 'Controller ready; no local transmitter output.' not in log.read_text():
   if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('role exited before readiness: '+log.read_text()[-1800:])
   if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise RuntimeError('role readiness deadline: '+log.read_text()[-1800:])
   time.sleep(.1)
  histories=[]
  for path in home.glob('.wsprrypi-pairing-*/authority.json'):
   value=json.loads(path.read_text())
   if value.get('schema')=='pi-management-pair-history/1':histories.append(path)
  assert len(histories)==1,'trusted controller pairing initialization missing'
  assert ini.read_text()==text,'controller role rewrote transmitter INI'
  process.terminate();assert process.wait(timeout=12)==0,'controller shutdown failed'
  print(json.dumps({'readiness_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'peak_child_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss,'controller_ready':True,'pairing_initialization':True,'transmitter_ini_unchanged':True,'clean_process_exit':True,'hardware_disabled':os.environ.get('WSPRRYPI_DISABLE_HARDWARE_ACCESS')=='1','binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/artifact/wsprrypi').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
 finally:
  if process.poll() is None:
   process.kill();process.wait(timeout=5)
